contracts: conflict resolution cannot bypass state machine
security_boundaries: vault isolated by authenticated org/user; logout clears projections and closes handle
tenant_boundaries: IndexedDB name includes authenticated org/user; auto flush cannot use another identity vault

findings.evidence: The offline IndexedDB was globally named ewoh-offline and opened once regardless of authenticated identity.
findings.impact: On a shared device, pending actions and exception photos from one worker could be displayed or auto-flushed after another worker logged in.
findings.fix: Scoped offline vault names by authenticated org/user, subscribed to auth changes, closed/cleared projections on identity transition, and opened a fresh identity-scoped vault.

contracts: offline status uses current authenticated vault

findings.evidence: Offline status probe used the global unscoped vault.
findings.impact: Shell badge could count another identity’s pending actions after account switch.
findings.fix: Probe now derives scope from authenticated org/user.
